children: Samsung Electronics said on Thursday its operating profit rose nearly ninefold to a record high in the third quarter, driven by robust demand for AI chips, even as investors remained wary about the durability of AI spending.

The world's top memory chipmaker reported operating profit of 107.4 trillion won ($80.04 billion) for the July-to-October period, in line with its estimate and up from 12.2 trillion won a year earlier.

Its cross-town rival SK Hynix on Wednesday reported strong earnings and an upbeat outlook, helping to ease market concerns that AI-driven chip earnings could lose momentum, driving up shares of Samsung and SK Hynix.
Echoing SK Hynix's outlook on demand, Samsung said the chip supply shortage would deepen next year.
Samsung said it would pay 30 trillion won in dividends for the third quarter ended in September, or 4,601 won per share.

title: Samsung posts record profit in Q3 on AI chip boom
